meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 加频道、改触发词、接新工具或做其他定制时，Claude 会先提问澄清需求，随后优先调取现成的添加/管理命令（如 /add-telegram）或直接修改配置与代码，最后告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想添加新渠道（如 Telegram、Slack 等）、修改触发词、添加集成，或要求 NanoClaw 做任何其他改动时。

say.text: 我想给 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 作为输入渠道。
say.note: 会先问你想接到哪个 agent 组、是否新建。

say.text: 把 A 组的触发规则里加上关键词“报表”。
say.note: 它会更新该 agent 组的路由触发规则。

say.text: 把 Gmail 工具接入到 NanoClaw 里。
say.note: 它会跑专门的 /add-gmail-tool 安装流程。

howto.what_en: When you ask to add channels, change triggers, integrate new tools, or make other NanoClaw customizations, Claude first asks clarifying questions, then prefers ready-made add/manage commands (like /add-telegram) or edits config/code directly, and finally tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: When you want to add a new channel (e.g., Telegram, Slack, etc.), change triggers, add integrations, or make any other NanoClaw customization.

say_en.text: I'd like to add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It will first ask which agent group to connect and whether to create a new one.

say_en.text: Add the keyword 'report' to the trigger rules for group A.
say_en.note: It updates the wiring trigger rules for that agent group.

say_en.text: Integrate the Gmail tool into NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It prefers running the dedicated /add-gmail-tool flow.
